urls.title: PDF links or file names
urls.description: One PDF per line: a direct http(s) link, or the name of a file you uploaded to this run's key-value store. Up to 100 documents per run.

pages.title: Pages (optional)
pages.description: Leave empty for every page. Use ranges and single pages, for example 1-3,7. At most 500 pages are read per document: pages above that are counted in pagesOverLimit, pages outside the document are counted in pagesDroppedCount and the first 20 of them are listed in pagesDropped.

includeTables.title: Extract tables
includeTables.description: Also return tables found on each page, as rows of cells. Table detection works on lined and well-spaced tables; a page with no tables returns an empty list.

maxCharsPerDocument.title: Max characters per document
maxCharsPerDocument.description: Text is cut at this many characters and the row is marked truncated, so one huge PDF cannot break your dataset.

password.title: Password for encrypted PDFs (optional)
password.description: Applied to every document in the run. A PDF that stays locked comes back as ENCRYPTED with a reason and is not charged.

maxDocuments.title: Max documents
maxDocuments.description: The list is cut here. Documents beyond the limit come back as rows with status NOT_CHECKED_LIMIT, their own link in source, and are not charged. 0 means no limit, and the summary reports the number actually applied.
